detail: Transcribed 2026-09-02 from tactic-mainqa-ds-storybook-visual (git archive holds the full node; serves strategy-show-not-tell). Park reason: human visual judgment in a local Storybook browser session (~15 min) — no CI runs Storybook; migrated 2026-07-06 from the legacy gh main-qa queue, source issue 2524 (needs-main residue from the ds component work, issue 2510, PR 2517). Checklist: (1) Run `npm run storybook --prefix packages/ds` against main and open each component story in a browser. (2) IBM Plex fonts load — text renders in IBM Plex, not a fallback system font. (3) Design tokens (colors, spacing) apply and match the ds token definitions. (4) Each component's story variants are visually distinguishable, e.g. Button primary vs secondary vs ghost differ. (5) No unstyled or broken stories anywhere in the Storybook UI. Operational note carried from the node: the dev server needs optimizeDeps.esbuildOptions.target es2022 alongside build.target (known crash otherwise), and never `pkill -f storybook`.
subject: mainqa (author-required): Human visual smoke of the ds Storybook — IBM Plex fonts load, design tokens apply, and every component's variants are visually distinguishable
